segments.text: Have some really cool ideas around this new video for the launch of the Ivy product. It has Arabella running through a street defending off bad guys. And then at the end of that, she jumps over a roof and then opens up the device in her hands and then radios through and says, I've got it.
Oh, and by the way, I just forgot. I need to have milk for the office for Thursday.
segments.boundary_marker: and by the way, I just forgot

cards.title: Launch video: street chase, rooftop reveal
cards.gist: A launch video where the performer sprints through a street fending off attackers, leaps a rooftop, opens the device in her hands and radios in "I've got it."
cards.frame_brief: a woman mid-leap over a rooftop edge, holding an open small handheld device in both hands above a narrow street
